reviewFlags.title: Inventory count and roll-forward differ
reviewFlags.detail: Inventory & COGS schedule row 44: 80,000 opening + 459,000 purchases - 405,000 COGS - 22,000 write-down = 112,000 closing (D048/D075/D086). Physical count shows 121,000; the 9,000 eur gap is not recognised and is disclosed as an open item (see D075/D091).

reviewFlags.title: Event Things supplier balance
reviewFlags.detail: File 06 lists EUR 59,000 unpaid for Event Things Europe and says supplier balances are independently confirmed. The bank export shows EUR 100,000 paid against the EUR 114,000 invoice, implying EUR 14,000 unpaid. The student certified EUR 14,000 in D013/D063/D084. The conflict remains visible for review; no answer has been changed. Student basis: Bank shows one payment of 100000 eur to Event Things Europe 31 Aug, ref SUP-EVT, no other payment to this supplier anywhere in the bank export. 06 Purchases invoice is 114000 eur. The 59000 eur unpaid note in 06 is not third party confirmed, it contradicts the bank, so 114000 minus 100000 paid equals 14000 eur unpaid.

reviewFlags.title: Approval of corrected accounts
reviewFlags.detail: Management's deck claims profit 312000 eur and cash 186000 eur, both contradicting the bank and resting on undelivered deposits, a loan booked as income, and omitted write-offs. Corrected profit is 65000 eur and corrected cash 60000 eur, both agreeing with the bank and its independent confirmation (247000 eur and 126000 eur below management's claims). Agent 1 proposed withholding approval until the 45000 eur supplier gap, 9000 eur inventory gap and missing insurance were resolved; the 45000 eur supplier gap is already resolved in D013 (Event Things Europe unpaid is 14000 eur, not 59000 eur), leaving only the 9000 eur inventory gap and missing insurance as genuinely open, so I approve with those two disclosed rather than blocking on them. Corrected balance sheet totals: assets 531000 eur, liabilities 361000 eur, equity 170000 eur - not 406000/125000 as the agents originally computed, because that figure assumed a 45000 eur opening supplier payable that does not exist once D013 is applied. Working from opening balances (cash 80000 + receivables 35000 + inventory 80000 + PPE net 135000 = 330000 opening assets; loan 100000 + payroll payable 15000 + supplier payable 0 = 115000 opening liabilities), opening equity is 215000 eur, not 170000 eur. Closing equity = 215000 + 65000 profit - 110000 distributions = 170000 eur. Closing liabilities = 81000 supplier + 32000 payroll + 25000 legal + 2000 interest + 131000 loan + 90000 deposits = 361000 eur. 531000 = 361000 + 170000, balances.
